Missing latest metrics become zero in summary fields, which cannot prove healthy traffic; unknown target size preserves null powered capacity and active-cell counts. operationalEntries.summary: Collects dashboard, director administrative status and 11 Google SQL/director/auth metrics in parallel; any top-level rejection fails collection. Lock waits use freshest per-series samples and preserve future timestamps for freshness refusal. Director admin POST uses audience-bound identity token, normalized complete selectors and serial cell reads; each source/target evacuation-status query sets completeReady=false, preventing this observational call from finalizing evacuation. Time-series pageSize 1000 and alert pageSize 100 have no next-page traversal or explicit incompleteness refusal. operationalEntries.summary: Google Run/SQL/MIG/template/backend/certificate readers use 30-second requests and schema validation.
